$comment: AUTHORED-BY Claude Opus 5.5. Every Solid identity provider the suite advertises on a sign-in screen, and the app clients checked against each. test/sign-in-providers.test.mjs fails when a provider is advertised without an entry here; scripts/sign-in-live/check.mjs and the live Playwright suite run against these entries on a schedule (.github/workflows/sign-in-live.yml).

providers.name: idp.solid-test.jeswr.org
providers.advertisedBy: Home provider default in the Vite apps, Pod Manager and the App Store
providers.fullLogin: Playwright signs up a throwaway account through Drive, then signs in again with it (apps/pod-drive/web/tests/live)

loginPage.$comment: Keycloak's username and password form, reached through the broker

providers.name: solidcommunity.net
providers.advertisedBy: @jeswr/pod-auth KNOWN_PROVIDERS and the suite's default provider list
providers.fullLogin: Not automated: needs a maintainer-provided account. The protocol check proves the app's request reaches the login page.

loginPage.$comment: CSS renders its sign-in UI client-side from the account app at /.account/

providers.name: Inrupt PodSpaces
providers.advertisedBy: @jeswr/pod-auth KNOWN_PROVIDERS and the suite's default provider list
providers.fullLogin: Not automated: needs a maintainer-provided account. The protocol check proves the app's request reaches the login page.

providers.name: teamid.live
providers.advertisedBy: @jeswr/pod-auth KNOWN_PROVIDERS and the suite's default provider list
providers.fullLogin: Not automated: needs a maintainer-provided account. The protocol check proves the app's request reaches the login page.

removed.why: Its /authorize answers 401 to every Client Identifier Document client_id (checked from GitHub Actions for Drive and the suite), so no suite app can sign in there. Removed from @jeswr/pod-auth KNOWN_PROVIDERS; re-add with a live entry here once it accepts Client ID Documents or pod-auth gains a registration fallback.
